future_state_evidence_contract.acquisition_policy: no RPC, no paid probe, no retry, and no acquisition-control request emitted unless one row passes all offline gates
required_for_token2022: mint and account TLV extensions from exact raw bytes
hook program/config and ordered dependency accounts
native/wrapped-native and lifecycle effects when applicable
future_state_evidence_contract.temporal_limit: later getAccountInfo, simulation, or present-day state does not establish historical bank state

limitations: 16 captured full blocks are a frozen selected-slot sample, not global market completeness.
Writable privilege is only a conservative potential-write indicator; program semantics and actual writes are not inferred.
No historical account state was fetched or reconstructed; this is feasibility only.
No economic equation, fee, settlement, Token-2022 effect, or decoder/class admission is qualified.
A later independent economic audit still requires a fresh disjoint frozen sample after the state path and predicate are qualified.
